item.title: Watchdog targets taxpayer-funded National Academies over DEI, climate and transgender spending
item.summary: Consumers' Research issues a Woke Alert against NASEM, accusing the taxpayer-funded body of pushing DEI, transgender ideology, and climate activism.

item.title: Beloved coffee shop owner, mother of two disappears near home, urgent search underway
item.summary: Amy Hillyard, 52, an Oakland coffee shop owner and mother of two, has been reported missing near Lake Merritt and is considered at-risk due to a medical condition.

item.title: Trump speaks with the family of Sheridan Gorman, college student allegedly slain by illegal immigrant
item.summary: President Donald Trump spoke with the family of Sheridan Gorman, an 18-year-old allegedly killed by an illegal immigrant in Chicago, a White House official confirmed to Fox News.

item.title: Nancy Guthrie disappearance sparked harrowing 12-hour odyssey for Savannah
item.summary: Savannah Guthrie recounts the frantic 12-hour ordeal after her mother vanished from her Tucson home, with ransom demands and a $1.2M reward offered.

item.title: Arnold Schwarzenegger's son dominates bodybuilding debut with multiple first-place wins
item.summary: Arnold Schwarzenegger's son Joseph Baena claimed multiple first-place wins at the NPC Natural Colorado State competition, a qualifier on the pathway to the Olympia.

item.title: Homeland Security vows deportation operations ‘will continue’ as ICE agents help TSA, agency defunded
item.summary: ICE officers are continuing deportation operations despite a lapse in federal funding and agents being deployed to assist with airport security lines across the country.

item.title: LeAnn Rimes breaks down into tears while undergoing 'deep jaw release'
item.summary: LeAnn Rimes broke down in emotional tears after a deep jaw release with Human Garage, saying years of TMJ tension had affected how freely she could sing.

item.title: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan gives strong take on starting season in Australia: 'I don't see any pro'
item.summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan says he sees "no pro" to opening the season in Melbourne, Australia, as the NFL schedules its first-ever game "Down Under."

item.title: NBA legend Michael Jordan explains being 'cursed' by competition: 'Keeps me young'
item.summary: Michael Jordan said he's "cursed" with a competitive gene, and it's fueling his 23XI Racing's strong rise to the top of the 2026 NASCAR Cup standings.

item.title: SEE THE DIFFERENCE: Emergency TSA lanes undergo drastic transformation at major airport after Trump action
item.summary: Emergency security lanes at Houston’s George Bush Intercontinental Airport were seen being cleared by staff on Monday after President Donald Trump signed an executive order to pay TSA.
